title: Hand off to Bambu Connect with the owner checklist
goal: The sliced job opens in the vendor app and the owner starts it there
acceptance: The file opens in Bambu Connect through its import link; the owner checklist is sent to the channel
NERV never says the print started; an Orange action because a desktop app is opened
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
